user.title: SunSpec connection
user.description: How is the SunSpec device connected?

tcp.title: SunSpec Modbus TCP connection
tcp.description: Enter the device host, port, and Unit ID to connect to your SunSpec device.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the device, or of its Modbus TCP gateway.
data_description.port: Modbus TCP port of the device, usually 502.
data_description.unit_id: Unit ID, or slave ID, that the device serves SunSpec on, as its Modbus documentation gives it.

serial.title: SunSpec Modbus RTU connection
serial.description: Enter the serial port, such as /dev/ttyUSB0, its baud rate and parity, and the Unit ID of your SunSpec device.

data_description.device: Serial port of the RS485 adapter, such as /dev/ttyUSB0.
data_description.baudrate: Speed set on the device, such as 9600.
data_description.parity: Parity set on the device; data bits are always 8 and stop bits 1.
data_description.unit_id: Unit ID, or slave ID, that the device serves SunSpec on, as its Modbus documentation gives it.

settings.title: Sensor options
settings.description: Enter an optional prefix for sensor names and select any additional SunSpec models (data registers) you would like to create sensors for. This can also be changed later in the component configuration.

data_description.prefix: Text put in front of every sensor name, to tell devices apart.
data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between reads of the device.

reconfigure.title: SunSpec connection
reconfigure.description: Update how Home Assistant connects to this SunSpec device.

data_description.host: IP address or hostname of the device, or of its Modbus TCP gateway.
data_description.port: Modbus TCP port of the device, usually 502.
data_description.device: Serial port of the RS485 adapter, such as /dev/ttyUSB0.
data_description.baudrate: Speed set on the device, such as 9600.
data_description.parity: Parity set on the device; data bits are always 8 and stop bits 1.
data_description.unit_id: Unit ID, or slave ID, that the device serves SunSpec on, as its Modbus documentation gives it.

error.connection: Failed to connect, check the connection settings
error.device_error: Connection reached the device, but initialization failed. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.
error.timeout: Connection timed out. Check that the device is online and responding on the configured host, port, and Unit ID.
error.no_sunspec: No SunSpec data found at this unit ID. Check which unit ID the device serves SunSpec on.

abort.already_configured: This device is already set up. Its entry now uses the connection entered here.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The device at these settings has another serial number than this entry's device. Add it as a new device instead.

model_options.title: Device Options
model_options.description: Select what SunSpec models (data registers) you would like to create sensors for.

data_description.prefix: Text put in front of every sensor name, to tell devices apart.
data_description.scan_interval: Seconds between reads of each model without its own interval below.
data_description.allow_writing: Lets Home Assistant change device settings over Modbus, which has no authentication. Wrong values can break grid rules, and the device must allow control in its own settings. Applies to models 123, 124 and 704 among those read.

model_intervals.name: Poll interval per model
model_intervals.description: Seconds between reads of a model. A model left empty is read at the scan interval.

abort.connection: Failed to connect, check the connection settings
abort.device_error: Connection reached the device, but initialization failed. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.
abort.timeout: Connection timed out. Check that the device is online and responding on the configured host, port, and Unit ID.
abort.no_sunspec: No SunSpec data found at this unit ID. Check which unit ID the device serves SunSpec on.

write.name: Write
write.description: Writes points of a SunSpec model to the device in one go, then reads the model back.

device_id.name: Device
device_id.description: The model's device, such as Immediate Controls, Storage or DER AC Controls, of an entry with Allow writing on.

points.name: Points
points.description: Point names, as an entity's sunspec_key attribute shows them, with their values: numbers in the units the entities show, enum points by name.

not_writable_device.message: This device has no points to write: it must be the device of model 123, 124 or 704 in a loaded entry with Allow writing on.

not_writable_point.message: {point} is not a writable point of this model that the device reports.

invalid_value.message: {value} is not a valid value for {point}.

write_unconfirmed.message: The write is not confirmed: {error}. The device may hold all or part of it, so the written points are unavailable until the next read.
